## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: State only in text 4-22 (RS loose); Dr, unit weight and gp not printed. Text 4-22: ratio of impacting mass to footpad area about the same as Test No. II-1. Full-scale pad is identical to the LM footpad in size and contour, epoxy/glass fiber with a spun-aluminum skin (text 3-35). Rig mass range about 570 to 1300 pounds (text 3-32, PDF 173). Velocity only about six fps; gravity not printed.
- Codex: M1 = 1140 lbs. Text says force versus time. The plot shows displacement. Fill depth and Dr unreported. Exact impact speed, bed unit weight and Gp unreported. Earth gravity inferred.
